title: [BUG] Dual watchface displays outdated IOB values due to delayed broadcast; dev3 and dev
body: Dual watchface displays an outdated IOB value received from AAPSCLIENT2. Observed: IOB inside AAPSCLIENT2 is current Broadcasted IOB value is delayed/not synced correctly Watchface therefore displays stale IOB BG and COB appear correct Example: Watchface showed IOB 0.21 Actual current IOB on phone was 0.73 Environment: AAPS V4 V4Client2 broadcasting to V3Client connected to watch Issue reportedly existed previously as well Expected behavior: Broadcasted IOB should stay synchronized/current Or stale IOB should be clearly marked Or outdated IOB should not be displayed [AndroidAPS_LOG_1779613988852.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28211806/AndroidAPS_LOG_1779613988852.log.zip) [AndroidAPS_LOG_1779613998372.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28211807/AndroidAPS_LOG_1779613998372.log.zip)

comments.body: you cannot mix versions. all must be the same
and next time be more specific please. what screenshot and log is from what device etc

and .... control question:
Broadcasting is designed like following:
`AAPS <- Client1 <- Client2 <- Client 3`
ie. Client 1 cannot broadcast to Client2. Data is allowed only from right side. The reason is automatic evaluation what is displayed in 2nd slot

Does your setup match?

sorry, for being too unspecific. Sequence was correct. Client 2 to Client 1. By AAPS you mean watch, right?
I might have to  switch my other kid to V4 as well....  When I do so; I will report back and provide accuarte LogFiles.
